findings.evidence: `grep -rn "FiltrationGradedPiece\|filtrationAssociatedGraded\b" --include=*.lean TauCeti` returns no definition; PBW.lean:298-300 reads `noncomputable def filtrationAssociatedGradedEquivExterior : AssociatedGraded (ι Q) ≃ₐ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M`, and PBW.lean:60-61 `noncomputable def filtrationGradedPieceEquivExteriorPower : (n : ℕ) → GradedPiece (ι Q) n ≃ₗ[R] ⋀[R]^n M`.
findings.fix: Rename to the surviving definitions with their namespace dropped per the naming guide ("When referring to a namespaced definition in a lemma name not in the same namespace, the definition should have its namespace removed"): `CliffordAlgebra.gradedPieceEquivExteriorPower` and `CliffordAlgebra.associatedGradedEquivExterior` (with their `_apply…`/`_symm_apply…` derivatives), updating the private helpers `filtrationGradedPieceZeroEquivExteriorPower`, `filtrationGradedPieceToExteriorDirectSum`, `filtrationAssociatedGradedToExteriorDirectSum` and all uses in the same PR.

summary: The new generic word-filtration graded API is named correctly (kind-appropriate casing, standard terminology, suffixes matching statement strength, no notation). But the Clifford consumers in PBW.lean keep `filtrationGradedPiece…`/`filtrationAssociatedGraded…` prefixes naming declarations this PR removed.
